requirement.summary: Support to sync SLC Member Information from TMS to POS for auto Set Member
requirement.description:
Refer to HERO-43809, the auto set member function for SLC member is not working when Seat-in from TMS and open the check in POS.

Request the further development to fix this feature.

Here is the original request on this feature request:

Enhancement Details:

when mark arrival for the reservation in TMS, pass the SLC Member Number and Last Name and Email to POS, then attach member to the check

SLC Member Number = membership number
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-63345] Support to sync SLC Member Information from TMS to POS for auto Set Member
Descriptions:
It is available for Golden Circle membership interface (SLC)
System supports attaching SLC member in the following API portal requests:
Send Check
Mark Arrival
Workflow of send check via API portal
1. System receives API portal send check request with SLC member number and member last name
2. System processes send check request
3. If the interface code is NOT given in request OR the code is NOT SLC, go to step 11
4. If the interface code is SLC, go to step 5
5. System triggers external party API for Member Enquiry API with using the SLC member number and member last name
6. If there is connection problem OR external party returned error OR invalid response, go to step 11
7. If the external party returned success but there is no member profile exists in the response, go to step 11
8. If the external party returned success but there is at least one member profile exists in the response, system uses the first member profile to trigger external party API for Fetch Profile
9. If there is connection problem / external party returned error / invalid response, go to step 11
10. If the external party returned success, system attaches SLC member into the check
11. System continues the remaining procedures of send check
12. If API send check request is successfully done but cannot attach member because of step 6 / step 7 / step 9, API response include “fail_to_attach_member” as warning message
Workflow of mark arrival via API portal
1. System receives API portal mark arrival request with SLC member number and member last name
2. System follows existing handling to save the interface ID and new param about SLC member number and member last name into POS outlet table
3. Click a table with mark arrival status at POS client
4. If the POS outlet table saved membership interface ID is NOT as SLC membership interface, follow existing handling that workflow ends here
5. If the POS outlet table saved membership interface ID is as SLC membership interface, go to step 6
6. If the new param about SLC member number is NOT in POS outlet table record, go to step 14
7. If the new param about SLC member number is in POS outlet table record, go to step 8
8. System triggers external party API for Member Enquiry API with using the SLC member number
9. If there is connection problem / external party returned error / invalid response, system follows existing handling to write station log about fail to attach member and go to step 14
10. If the external party returned success but there is no member profile exists in the response, system follows existing handling to write station log about fail to attach member and go to step 14
11. If the external party returned success but there is at least one member profile exists in the response, system uses the first member profile to trigger external party API Fetch Profile
12. If there is connection problem / external party returned error / invalid response, system follow existing handling to write station log about fail to attach member and go to step 14
13. If the external party returned success, system attach SLC member into the check
14. System continues remaining procedures of open a check
15. Click function “SVC Enquiry”
16. Select target SLC membership interface
17. If SLC member is attached to check already because of step 13, system follows existing handling to show the attached member in the member enquiry UI
Setup:
None
